headline: Duffields Pledge $250M to Make Vet Care Affordable
meta_description: Dave and Cheryl Duffield commit $250 million over five years to expand affordable veterinary care through nonprofit clinics across America.
summary_short: A major philanthropic commitment aims to remove cost barriers keeping American families from accessing veterinary care for their pets.
body:
Dave and Cheryl Duffield have committed $250 million over five years to help make veterinary care affordable for American families. The initiative is already funding nonprofit clinics designed to serve communities where pet care costs have long been a barrier to treatment.

The effort addresses a real gap in access. Many families delay or skip veterinary visits because of expense, leaving pets without preventive care or treatment for illness. By directing resources toward nonprofit clinics, the Duffields' commitment creates a sustainable model that can serve broader populations while keeping costs manageable.

This funding represents a tangible step toward removing financial obstacles from pet healthcare, enabling more American families to provide necessary medical attention to their animals.
quick_facts: Dave and Cheryl Duffield pledged $250 million
Goal: make vet care affordable for American families
